stretch: mask 0 (the shipped default) declines everything and draws nothing

stretch declines (nothing drawn, no engine access): bad size/ABI/depth/flags, unsupported source depth, bad stride/length/address, source or clip range errors, over 4096, zero factor, failed page lock (no unlock), 3D busy; then a good request still works
stretch of a partial bitmap (DibToDevice with a clip showing 3 of 9 rows): only those rows are locked and read
stretch: the registry reset puts the class mask back to ACCEL_STRETCH (default 0)
stretch while a DirectDraw async blit is running: the blit completes first (registers restored, lock released), then the stretch draws over it; the exclusive-mode gate is dropped
v10.132: 1-bit sources into 32bpp through the fused nibble-table expansion and through the old index-byte line give the same pixels (44 cases, odd widths, every start bit, stretched and 1:1)

176 stretches of 1-bit, 4-bit, RLE8 and RLE4 sources into the 32bpp screen (factors 1:1 and 1..4, bottom-up and top-down raw bitmaps, negative origins, clips, source columns that start inside a byte): pixels equal the palette reference, the locked range is exactly the bytes read (the whole stream for RLE), engine untouched; each class bit takes only its class, mask 1 and mask 0 take nothing, the 16bpp screen declines them all

RLE streams the VxD must leave to DIBENG, each refused by the decoder (counted): delta codes, rows that end short or run over, missing or extra rows, a missing end of bitmap, an early end of line, absolute runs cut off or over the row, empty and one-byte streams; also top-down RLE, a stride that is not the width, no width, a bitmap above the 262144-pixel decode buffer, an empty stream, the RLE flag on a 16-bit source, no palette, 1-bit and 4-bit with a palette of the wrong size, 2-bit and 3-bit sources, the 565 flag on a 1-bit source
the registry reset puts class mask 2 back to ACCEL_STRETCH2 (default 0)

.592: with the ring-paused idle rule in use, a fill the command regulator holds for 1, 20 or 200 status reads (status 0x10, 444 bit 31) is finished when the request returns, GDI and DirectDraw, 16 and 32 bpp; the waits are counted and the engine was seen busy in each

.593: a fill whose first 1, 2 or 3 status reads are 00000000 before the engine shows busy is finished when the request returns (GDI and DirectDraw, 16 and 32 bpp, nothing pending, the ring-paused rule not in use)
